notes: Argentine Malbec is deep in color, with intense fruit and a velvety texture.
Heat in most regions gives soft, ripe tannins and high alcohol, and in very warm areas acidity can run low.
Torrontés makes fresh, aromatic whites with floral, Muscat-like aromas, peach and apricot, and moderate acidity.
Uco Valley wines are deep in color, intense in aroma and rich in flavor.
